description: Create or edit a page on a DAO's company-layer wiki. Holders only – any amount of the DAO's token, its vote token or its founder badge. Pass the body as one HTML string; it becomes a standard content block (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables). Requires the Bearer token from the `login` tool, sent as an HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on the POST carrying this call.

daoId.description: Cashtag of the DAO whose wiki to edit

tagPath.description: Optional tag path, e.g. "updates" ("" = top level)

name: save_wiki_page
title: Create or edit a DAO wiki page
